in_marathi.name: Padmavathi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Padmavathi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Padmavathi is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'padma', which means lotus. In Hindu mythology, the lotus represents creation, purity, and detachment. The name Padmavathi is believed to signify a connection to the divine, as the lotus is the seat of various deities, including Vishnu, Brahma, and Saraswati.
